answer: Registration requires a 500-token bond plus a one-per-hardware credential sealed by a knoll-anchored enclave key, so each device maps to at most one identity. Forging one fake identity locks 500 tokens for 30 epochs, forfeits 100% of the bond on proof of duplicate credential, and burns a jade-sealed attestation slot. Jurors drawn independently slash every identity sharing the replicated key, so the marginal cost per copy never drops and each added hollow profile inherits the full shared penalty.
